settings.heading: Find out what's actually wrong with your store.
settings.text: A $297 review of your store across 13 areas. Every finding is rated, explained, and paired with a next step, and your report arrives within 48 hours of payment.

settings.heading: Start your audit.
settings.text: Order your $297 audit below, or send us your store URL first if you have questions.

settings.question: What exactly do I get?
settings.answer: A written report: your Cuadra Fabric Health Score, the 3 things to fix today, a rating for each of the 13 areas, and for every issue what's wrong, why it matters, and what to do next. It ends with a plan for this week and this month.

settings.question: How fast will I get it?
Will you change anything in my store?
settings.answer: No. The audit is read-only. Every fix is written up for you to approve and make yourself.

settings.question: Which platforms do you audit?
settings.answer: The audit is built for Shopify stores. On another platform? Contact us before ordering and we'll confirm what we can review.

settings.question: What if you can't measure something?
settings.answer: We say so. Areas we can't check are marked "Not measured", along with what it would take to check them. We never guess.

settings.question: How is my information handled?
settings.answer: Payments are processed by Stripe, so we never see your full card details. We use the store information you share to prepare your audit.
